description: A-4B ex USN BuNo 142838, on charge 1967, credited with damaging HMS Brilliant in 1982, retired May 1991; in a circular park at the IMPSA plant entrance since 1993-94, painted as C-221 with a ship-kill mark; free access. Reported by Los Andes October 2023.
